run_active_depth_viz: run the interactive active depth visualization tool with a ScanNet RGB and depth image pair
create_get_rgb_depth: create a function that loads an RGB image and depth map, normalizes depth, and returns log depth tensors
create_get_data: create a function that loads RGB and depth data, samples training coordinates, and sets up test coordinates
create_plot_rgb_and_coords: create a function that plots an RGB image with scattered sample coordinates on a matplotlib axis
create_on_click: create a click event handler that adds new depth samples and updates conditional mean and variance predictions
